title: docs.issue.created.v1
description: Docs created the GitHub issue a person approved in Flow, answering flow.issue.approved.v1, and saved its URL on the note. requestId is the id of the request event answered, so Flow can drop a late answer to an earlier attempt.

stepId.description: The run's step that waits for the answer (from the request)

requestId.description: The id of the flow.issue.approved.v1 event this answers

issueUrl.description: The created issue's URL on GitHub
